payload.featureSpecification:
Work Item Saved Views & Advanced Filtering

Add saved views to the project work item board so each member can filter, sort, and reuse board configurations.

1. Filtering
- Filter work items by status, priority, assignee, label, due date range, and parent item.
- Multiple filters combine with AND; values within one filter combine with OR.
- Filters apply to both board view and list view without a full page reload.

2. Saved views
- A member can save the current filter + sort combination as a named view (max 20 per project).
- Views can be personal or shared with the whole project.
- Shared views are visible to all project members; only the creator or a project admin can edit or delete them.
- The last used view is remembered per member and restored on next visit.

3. Sorting
- Sort by due date, priority, created date, or manual order.
- Sort preference is stored as part of the saved view.

4. API & data
- New saved_view resource: CRUD routes scoped to the project, with personal/shared visibility rules enforced server-side.
- Filter queries must use indexed columns; board responses for a 500-item project should return within 300ms.

5. UI
- Filter bar above the board with active-filter chips and a clear-all button.
- View switcher dropdown showing personal and shared views in separate sections.
- Empty state when a view's filters match no items.

6. Quality
- Unit tests for filter query building and visibility rules.
- E2E test covering create view, switch view, and shared view visibility for another member.
- Update user documentation for the new board controls.
